svg.title: Mitosis makes eight ordered spores
svg.desc: Each of four meiotic products gives two adjacent genetically identical spores. Two FDS octads are AAAAaaaa and aaaaAAAA. Four SDS octads are AAaaAAaa, aaAAAAaa, aaAAaaAA and AAaaaaAA, in source order. Branches explicitly connect each of four products to its two spores in every alternative. Alternative product orders arise during meiosis, not mitosis.
svg.metadata: Original editable schematic after source slide 60. Source: genetics/LECT09/lect09b-tetrads_1_introduction.odp, source art in ordered_before_meiosis.svg, ordered_meiosis_ii.svg and ordered_mitosis.svg. Unmeasured. A is green, a is purple. Source and stage ledger: SOURCE_STATE.json. Reconstruction 2026-11-09.

g.text: Each branch gives an adjacent pair.
during meiosis; mitosis keeps the order.
